description: A three-part omnibus consisting of Kino Klub amateurs' work: Zivojin Pavlovic's dialogue-free "Live Waters" set in 1943, Marko Babac's "Warriors" about psychological look at the two patients in a hospital room, as well as Kokan Rakonjac's "Raindrops" about alcoholic's decaying relationship with his girlfriend.

Title: 631. Pattinathar
description: Life of a man changes when he realizing the truth.

Title: 634. Rocket Girl
description: This 1962 movie follows the adventures of an Indian scientist and his team who build a rocket where they fly on, then land on an unfamiliar planet and the moon.

Title: 636. Locust Tree Village
description: Aunt Guo led the poor peasant league playing an active part in land-reform movement before liberation. Now she leads villagers setting up people's commune.

Title: 638. Hariyali Aur Rasta
description: Shanker and Rita's marriage is finalized by their elders in their childhoods, however, after growing up, Shanker loves Shobna. Shanker is told to marry Rita instead, and he does so. The marriage is rocky as Rita does not pay attention to her husband and son. Then Shobna re-enters their life. Memorable songs too: "Ilfizaye ishq me hum sari raat jaghe, allah jaane kya hoga aage, oh mollah jaane kya hoga aage..."; "Ye hariyali aur ye raasta, ein rahon par tera mera jivan bar ka vasta..."; "Bol meri taqdeer me kya hai mere humsafar ab to bata jivan ke do pehlu hain, hariyali aur raasta..."; "Kho gaya hai mera pyar, dhundta hoon main mera pyar..."; "Teri yaad dil se bhulane chala hoon, ke khud apni hasti mitane chala hoon..."; "Lakhon tare aasman me ek magar dhundhe na mila, dekke duniya ki diwali dil mera chup chap jala...".

Title: 639. Vampiresas 1930
description: As the era of silent films finds itself at a close, four down-and-out silent film actors and musicians struggle to find work.

Title: 641. Das schwarz-weiß-rote Himmelbett
description: A satire on the romantic adventures of a youth who follows in the footsteps of his Don Juan like father.The student is sent away from Cologne where his family lives to a smaller town for falling in love with an actress,and is later expelled from school and lands up in the army just as they are preparing for a dangerous war.

Title: 643. Ah men Hawwa
description: Amira scares away any man who attempt to proposes to her. When her grandfather insists she gets married first before her younger sister, she's forced to marry Dr. Hassan. The two of them start a comedic game of cat and mouse.

Title: 644. Canción de juventud
description: Two seaside boarding schools-a boys' academy run by traditional Don César and a girls' school led by forward-thinking nuns-unite when the sisters convince the headmaster to join an excursion, leading them to restore an abandoned chapel.

Title: 646. Nenjil or Aalayam
description: Dr Murali finds out that Venu, the patient he is treating, is his former lover Sita's husband. Knowing that Sita would commit suicide if he dies, Murali dedicates himself to saving Venu.

Title: 647. Shirobanba
description: A drama about the childhood of a boy named Kosaku in a Japanese village in the early 20th century. He grows up under the care of his step-grandmother, experiencing the joys of growing up and the bitterness of his first losses.

Title: 648. Spetzialist po vsichko
description: A dentistry student, graduating with honor, does not get the desired job and has to start working as a MASTER OF ALL TRADES in a construction company. He has to paint walls, clean chimneys, and fix water conduits. He is not able to accomplish any of these tasks and gets into funny situations all the time. He and his roommate, a good friend of his, quarrel over a girl. But this situation is a misunderstanding as well - the friends love different girls. A happy end is in sight.

Title: 650. La risa de la ciudad
description: The underside of Mexico City: street performers, factory workers, a drunk, an old man with civic pride, a pickpocket, and others live and interact in a shantytown near the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe. Techo, the old man, longs to reconnect to his abandoned son; Beto, the robust son, is in love with Lita, but not married to her although she's pregnant. Government authorities see the shantytown residents as lazy and immoral; the residents celebrate their own love of family, communal spirit, and life's possibilities. Can responsibility also win out?

Title: 652. Tartarin de Tarascon
description: Tartarin lives in Tarascon, a small southern town, among his friends who, like him, adore hunting parties.

Title: 655. Have You Seen Panais?
description: Erotic tangles forced Fani and Panais to leave from Athens to Chalkida, there they await new adventures with women, which will result in marriage, but Panais will escape the wedding night.

Title: 656. Sexy
description: A collection of scenes featuring attractive women.

Title: 657. Dr. Vidya
description: The movie was shot in an era when educated people in cities were getting influenced by the western culture hence the people from rural areas who placed a lot of importance to values and culture, strongly abstained from marrying into city people's homes. Geeta is a girl from a well to do family and is well educated, her parents had brought up her with traditional values and respect for those values. After her graduation, her parents decide to marry her off with Ratan Chowdhury, the son of a zaminder, who had the mind frame that a highly educated wife would be incapable of handling and managing a home, specially in a joint family. Later he marries Geeta but his mentality and the talk of others stop him from accepting her. He disowns her and poor Geeta has to go back to her parents' house. Even after lot of insistence from her parents and friends she refuses to remarry. Instead she continues her studies to become a doctor. After garnering a degree in medical science she goes back to Ratan's village as Vidya. She wants to clear the wrong perceptions that Ratan has about her. Ratan couldn't recognise her, as he had not even seen her face, even during marriage. He falls in love with Vidya and intends to marry her, but one day during the annual cart race, Ratan meets with an accident and suffers a very bad injury post which needs surgery. Due to unavailability of any other doctor, Geeta has to do the job. She performs it successfully. Will Ratan accept Geeta in her new avataar?

Title: 658. The Bashful Elephant
description: Set in a traveling circus in Austria, the story centers around Tristie, a 12-year-old escapee from behind the Iron Curtain, who is hunted by the law, rescued by a giant border dog and "adopted" by an elephant.

Title: 659. Fallguy
description: A teenager trying to help an accident victim finds himself enmeshed in political corruption and racketeering and charged with a murder he didn't commit.

Title: 660. Vaarallista vapautta
description: The thriller Vaarallista vapautta (Dangerous Freedom) (1962), is based on Tuuli Reijonen's novel. Nurse Sinikka (Pirkko Peltonen) wants to help a prisoner (Toivo Lehkonen) who defected across the border from the Soviet Union. She and her fiance (Ville-Veikko Salminen) plan an escape trip for him from Finland with the help of her mother (Irma Seikkula). Sinika's brother's (Antti Litja) girlfriend Ruth (Maija Karhi) happens to witness the escape, which puts her accomplices in danger.

Title: 661. Typhoon
description: A clever and lively girl who gets lost in the world of radio drama runs away from home to search for her imaginary mother. A scoundrel claims to be the girl's father to escape from police. They encounter two women in the mountains: one is tortured by her workaholic husband who engages madly in his scientific research, the other is a pure and naive girl living in the mountains. Typhoon is now coming.

Title: 662. La muerte pasa lista
description: Masked hero with a bullwhip. Film number 2 of 4.

Title: 666. Zorro the Avenger
description: Don Jose disguises himself as Zorro, the masked freedom fighter, who tries to protect his people from the wrath of an evil military officer who is using his position to his own advantage.

Title: 667. La burrerita de Ypacaraí
description: Beautiful farmer's daughter Isabel can have any man in the village, but she falls in love with the wrong man and his sins cost both of them their lives at the Iguazú Falls.

Title: 668. The Girl Gogo
description: Ragnar has left his family farm and works as a taxi driver in Reykjavík in the early sixties. He's drawn to the beautiful but unhappy girl Gogo and hopes to build a better life with her. But she's a lost soul and their brief romance results in tragedy.

Title: 670. The Small Hours
description: An advertising executive and some friends go on an all-night pub crawl and lament about life, love, society, and existence in general.

Title: 671. A Woman's Life
description: Kei, a house servant, is kicked out after an altercation and is then adopted by a nearby family.

Title: 672. A Pair of Briefs
description: She's new in chambers, and he's a troublemaker. But what *is* the true status of the old lady's wartime marriage, and can the two young legal minds find the answer?

Title: 673. The Man from the First Century
description: A workman is accidentally sent into outer space, where he meets an alien that can make himself invisible. They return to Earth in the year 2447. Complications ensue.

Title: 674. L'assassin est dans l'annuaire
description: Fernandel plays Albert, the unhappy brunt of jokes by his fellow office-workers who goes from the frying pan into the fire. Albert gets caught up in a robbery that also goes from bad to worse when it leads to several murders. Although he is not a killer and essentially innocent, there does not seem to be very much that Albert can do to convince others of the truth.

Title: 675. Anno 79: La distruzione di Ercolano
description: Intrigue at the Roman Emperor's court prior to its destruction by Vesuvius.

Title: 676. Girl on Approval
description: 1961. Drama. Stars Oscar nominated. Rachel Roberts, James Maxwell and Annette Whiteley. A key example of British new wave, a great study of the uneasy life of 14 year old Sheila.

Title: 677. Story of San Michele
description: The memoirs of Swedish doctor Axel Munthe. Munthe was a fashionable physician in Paris who built one of the best-loved houses in the world - San Michele - on the Isle of Capri, on the site of the villa of the emperor Tiberius.

Title: 678. Frauenarzt Dr. Sibelius
description: Drama about a successful gynecologist, his jealous wife, an old flame who unexpectedly re-appears in his life, and the professional jealousy and intrigues in his work place.

Title: 679. De stille genieter
description: The story of Gaston, an apparently decent citizen, suspected of engaging in shady activities in his cosy home.

Title: 681. Tie pimeään
description: Klaus Grahn is a young law student in his early twenties. He has a loyal and nice blonde girlfriend Anita, but is drawn towards a new love interest, the dark haired and more exciting Eija. Frustrated by his small earnings writing bits and pieces for a newspaper he gets the idea for a perfect crime. He forges a check and cashes it in a bank, but the money runs out and now the police are after him. Desperate he boards a train to Tampere and robs a taxi there and shoots the driver with his sawn-off rifle. Getting back to Helsinki he succeeds in avoiding the police who have come to meet him at the train station. He contacts both his girlfriends, who still do not know of the killing. Anita tries to talk some sense to him but fails. Eija tries to comfort him with he loving feelings. After drinking in a bar, Klaus runs amok through the city. He thinks he has been turned in to the police by the girls. He confronts them for the last time - with the gun in his hands.

Title: 682. Black Lizard
description: A jeweler hires detective Akechi to find his daughter kidnapped by a famous thief known as the Black Lizard.

Title: 683. Caesar Against the Pirates
description: Julius Caesar flees Rome because of a conspirary against him and is given refuge the king of Bithnyia. He finds a woman there and while he escorts her to Rhodes their ship is attacked. Caught by the pirates he asks for help to get back to Rome.

Title: 684. Tower House
description: Mystery surrounds the ruins of an old tower house, where at select nights, a woman comes out wailing a song, amidst people committing suicide by throwing themselves off the tower. The police investigate this, but are baffled, and unable to solve this mystery. The woman is Seth Durgadas' late wife. The police interview Seth Durgadas but nothing comes of it. In the meantime, Ranjeet (N.A. Ansari) rescues Sabita (Shakila), the only daughter of Seth Durgadas from the clutches of a tiger, and himself is disfigured for life. Out of pity, Durgadas appoints him manager of his organization and wealth, and soon a greedy Ranjeet starts showing his true colors, which ultimately result in the murder of Durgadas, and the prime suspect is none other than Suresh Kumar (Ajit), the man who Sabita loves. Sabita changes her mind, and Suresh disappears from their lives, apparently on the run. Ranjeet plots and schemes to drive Sabita mad, so that he can take over her wealth. Will Ranjeet succeed? What is the secret of the Tower House?

Title: 685. Rakhi
description: Orphaned at a very young age, Raju and Radha are very close to each other. Radha takes care of the house, sells milk, paints dolls, etc. while Raju works in a mill. When the mill workers' union goes on strike, both of them start their own business of manufacturing and marketing toys. Soon they become rich. Raju would like Radha to get married to Advocate Ramesh Chandra so that he can marry his sister, Malti, but Radha has fallen in love with Anand, a man who had rescued her once, and would like to marry him. Raju gives his consent for both to get married, and they, together with Anand's sister, Nandini and her son, Kasturi, move into their palatial house. When Radha finds out that Raju lives Malti, she arranges his marriage with her and she too moves in with them. Soon misunderstandings start between Nandini, Malti and Radha, and as a result Raju and Malti leave the house. Then Raju gets a shock when he receives a letter from Radha's lawyer demanding half of the estate. By the looks of things it does appear that there is no more love lost between brother and sister, and their estate may be contested in a court of law - leaving nothing but bitterness and hatred on both sides.

Title: 687. Krst Rakoc
description: Shortly after World War II, the government sent a crew of drivers with large tractors to clear-cut and plow a vast, barren piece of land called "Krst Rakoc" in the hills of Kosovo and Metohia, for future orchards. They encounter deprecation and revolt from indigenous Albanian population who do not believe in good intentions of the government and the crew.

Title: 690. I Hate But Love
description: A celebrity impulsively leaves fast-paced Tokyo to deliver a much-needed jeep to a remote village. When his controlling manager, the woman he loves, follows, the two must reconcile while dodging reporters.

Title: 691. The Eye of the Monocle
description: In 1943, a German commando conceals a large quantity of gold in an undersea cave on the coast of Corsica. Years later, Schlumpf, the sole survivor of the commando, returns to Corsica to recuperate the treasure -- with British and Soviet spies on his heels, and closely monitored by Dromard, from the French intelligence services. The monocled Dromard is convinced that he can outfox his opponents, but difficulties accumulate: despite his plump appearance, Herr Schlumpf is a sly fellow; Corsica is teeming with treasure hunters from various nationalities; and all parties readily resort to unnatural alliances, brazen treachery, and strong-arm tactics. Who will get the treasure?

Title: 692. Sakhi Robin
description: This movie is loosely based on the legend of Robin Hood, albeit with a female lead rather than a male lead. When the king is held ransom by his treacherous brother a woman named Robin tries to free him by winning over the people.

Title: 693. Buscando a Mónica
description: A man has a street accident with his car in his way to Buenos Aires. While he waits for his car repairing, this business man learns that everybody in the little town where he's stuck seem to know about his wife Mónica. He knows little about her past, but the reactions of the townsfolk towards him range from laughing at his back to practically don't want him around. He won't leave the town until he could learn more about the secret past of his wife. But the former life of the young beautiful mother of his daughter involves a turbulent story.

Title: 694. Cerca de las estrellas
description: Barcelona, in the early sixties. On a hot summer Sunday the passions will unleash in the attic where Ricardo and Adela live together with their children, a large working family whose problems and illusions will continue throughout a day.

Title: 695. I tre nemici
description: A meek clerk is hunted by the counterespionage because he has a secret formula tattooed on his bottom.

Title: 697. Zwei Bayern in Bonn
description: Two morose village representatives from Upper Bavaria appear at the Bonn Ministry of Family Affairs and other government agencies to investigate alleged building plans for a nuclear reactor.

Title: 699. Samahang siyete
description: The elite of the katipunan chosen for their individual achievement unsurpassed courage incredible heroism.

Title: 700. The Zero Fighter
description: The stage is Solomon County Island at the end of WWII. Yujiro, who is dressed as a captain of the "rogue troops", left behind in the small islands, draws a way to lead the troops by a strong bond, eventually confronting the noncommissioner.

Title: 702. Stork Talk
description: A gynecologist's wife leaves him, but returns when she finds out she's pregnant; but so is someone her husband's been very friendly with in her absence. Coincidence?

Title: 704. El asesino enmascarado
description: The Masked Killer (1962). Anyone could be the masked killer in a lawless town.

Title: 705. Esös vasárnap
description: The heroes of the film are 17-year-old high school students. Ági is interested in school, movement work and getting their string quartet into the WFYS. Olga is interested in clothes, money and men. Pali Kaszás, the handsome practical teacher, takes a liking to Ági, but his disappointment drives him to Olga.

Title: 706. Ta Hristougenna tou aliti
description: Bent on confronting the unscrupulous swindler who bankrupted his late father, Petros instead falls in love with honest Marina. When a hideous crime sends him to prison, will he clear his name even as a penniless vagabond?

Title: 707. I'm Married, Ha Ha
description: During honeymoon, bride decides to "wait" until they get to know each other better.

Title: 708. El caballo blanco
description: Joselito makes a trip from Spain, when his Grandmother, who lives in a Mexican Village, demands his presence. While in the country, travelling on a Stagecoach towards his destination, the vehicle is attacked by bandits. However, the boy escapes, and meets Antonio, who becomes a good friend.

Title: 709. Sucker Groom
description: Two idiosyncratic friends compete for the attention of the neighbourhood's poor but charming seamstress. Unexpectedly, a winning lottery ticket fires the imagination of the ambitious Casanovas; however, should they build their hopes up?

Title: 711. World of Comedy
description: Hilarious scenes from his silent and sound films as compiled and produced by Harold Lloyd himself. There appears to be no age limit to the enjoyment, sub-teenagers guffaw as loudly as the older folks.

Title: 712. La bella Lola
description: La Bella Lola is a struggling singer trying to make a living for herself and her sister Ana in late-19th-century Spain. She falls in love with a high-society young man but his family refuses to accept her.

Title: 713. Rebel Gladiators
description: In order to persuade the Emperor to spare his village, the mighty Ursus is forced to fight the greatest gladiator in Rome in the Roman Arena.

Title: 714. Hong Kong Hot Harbor
description: A German journalist tries to track down his friend's murderer in Hong Kong and comes across a dubious gangster organization.

Title: 715. The Crimebusters
description: A feature film consisting of two 1962 episodes of the crime, drama show Cain's Hundred.

Title: 716. Han, Hun, Dirch og Dario
description: Poul Borg neglects his young, beautiful wife Marianne. He even forget their wedding day, in favor of a new fast sports car, a beautiful silver-gray Jaguar. During his drive, he runs out of gas. A young lady Laura Lublinski helps him.

Title: 717. La cuccagna
description: Rossella, a beautiful young girl that lives in a family of popular class, looks for a job every day but soon discovers that the economic miracle is only an illusion.

Title: 718. Las hijas del Amapolo
description: The story of four charming girls in a small town, trying to hang out with four boys.

Title: 719. To karpouzaki
description: Bursting with excitement before meeting a blonde hottie and her equally good-looking companion, a lascivious merchant lures his gullible old friend into a splendid afternoon by the sea behind his wife's back. But, will he get away with it?

Title: 720. When the Trees Were Tall
description: The story of a man who routinely dodges all responsibility, bemoans fate, spends his days boozing, and refuses to work. The act of playing long-lost father to a pretty teenager spurs him to turn over a new leaf.

Title: 721. Les culottes rouges
description: In French prison camps in Germany during WWII, those who tried to escape were forced to wear red pants. Anthony Rossi tried six times. Hard to live with, he exasperates his fellow captives. But this time, he manages to escape in the company of spineless Fendard. Generous and resourceful, Fendard Rossi helps when his mate is injured. But Anthony, in an atrocious gesture, tries to get rid of Fendard as they are boarding the train of freedom .

Title: 722. No Man's Land
description: A group of Italian refugees are captured by a German patrol during World War II. The German sergeant agrees to release them if one of the women agrees to his terms, leading the group to pressure her into agreeing to a terrible condition.

Title: 724. Our Marriage
description: Two sisters living in poverty reach the age when they start to attract marriage proposals. They must decide between marrying for love or money.

Title: 725. Short Is the Summer
description: Lieutenant Glahn arrives in a small village in northern Norway. He wants to live in peace in the company of his dog. The young Edvarda stirs emotions in the lieutenant.

Title: 726. Star of Hong Kong
description: Hsin Lin, the only daughter of a Hong Kong physician, meets and falls for Toru, a student at her college in Japan. But due to their busy scheduals, neither is willing to make a move on the other and they both fabricate stories about themselves so that they will not get engaged.

Title: 727. World Without Shame
description: After winning on the football pools, a group of young people leave London to begin a new, carefree, naturist life on a deserted Mediterranean island.

Title: 728. Futari de aruita iku haru aki
description: After WWII, an ex-soldier and his wife spend their lives working at modest jobs to raise their son and put him through school.

Title: 729. Der brænder en ild
description: Martin returns home with a good amount of money in his pocket after he has worked on Greenland.

Title: 730. Jhoola
description: Dr.Arun lives with his brother, Madhu; dad Judge Ramkrishan; and mom Kamla in a palatial house. He decides to help the poor and the needy and in order to do this he re-locates to a small town, where he meets with a young nurse named Sumati and both fall in love with each other. Sumati lives with her mom, Laxmi, and has no father. When Kamla starts looking for a prospective bride for Arun, he informs her that he has given his heart to Sumati. Ramkrishan sends for Laxmi, who gladly accepts the invitation. After her meeting, Arun inquires about the results with his mom and dad, and is told to forget about Sumati and marry someone else. When Arun asks for a reason behind their refusal, they refuse to divulge any information. The question remains, why did his parents turn down Sumati's mom, and what exactly happened during that meeting with her?

Title: 731. Una storia milanese
description: Milan, one winter in the early sixties. Valeria, a free young woman who usually goes from one man to another, falls in love with Giampiero. This time, this is a serious relationship to the point that she contemplates marriage. All the more since she gets pregnant. Will the free roaming girl finally settle down or will she return to her old ways?

Title: 732. Design for Loving
description: An unkempt, impoverished & dipsomaniac 'serious artist' gets a job as fashion designer.

Title: 733. Midnight Mass
description: Fascist Slovak State, Christmas Day 1944: regardless of this important Christian holiday, cruel Nazi repression is taking place in Slovakia. Men, women and children are executed by the hundreds by the Germans for taking part in the Slovak National Uprising and for merely helping the partisans. The Kubis family tries to survive the war as best they can, even if it means collaboration. Son Marian is a commander of the fascist guards, his cynical brother-in-law Palo runs a business and tries to keep a low profile as much as possible. Palo's wife Angela has begun an affair with Nazi Major Brecker, who is staying with the Kubis. However, a serious threat to everyone, including the grandparents, comes from their nineteen-year-old son Juraj, who fought with the partisans and managed to escape execution. The young man arrives home with an injured leg. While the Germans carry out house-to-house searches for the fugitive, Juraj waits in the attic for medical help and begins to delirious with fever. An "idyllic" Christmas Eve dinner takes place downstairs, to which Major Brecker himself has invited himself.

Title: 734. Warriors Five
description: In German-occupied Italy during World War II, an American paratrooper on a mission to blow up a bridge enlists the help of five Italians just released from a military prison, and a sexy Italian girl who joined up with them along the road.

Title: 735. Totò di notte n. 1
description: Ninì and Mimi are two friends, itinerant players, who can not make a penny.

Title: 737. Beach Casanova
description: Mr. Edmond is a middle-aged playboy, living by his wits on the Riviera. Among the women with whom Edmond dallies are three gorgeous ladies.

Title: 738. So toll wie anno dazumal
description: The singing trio of Susanne, Dieter and Juergen work at an unsuccessful student cabaret. Mr Brenders, a rich entrepreneur offers to fund them, if they change the name of the cabaret to the Lu-Lila bar with a roaring twenties motive. Disguised in black outfits and wigs, the trio soon find out Brenders has them recreating an unsolved murder case from 26 Februari 1927 in which he himself may or may not have been involved.

Title: 739. Four Winds of Heaven
description: The simple Russian girl Svetlana arrived in a back-water small town to the darling. But begun war, Igor did not have met Svetlana, and she determined on staying : to wait his return and war end.

Title: 740. Tyutyun
description: The film is a screen version of the novel by Dimitar Dimov (1909-1966) and deals with the conflicts and contradictions in Bulgarian society during a period stretching from the early thirties to the end of the Second World War.

Title: 741. Lemmy pour les dames...
description: A famous FBI agent's vacation is interrupted by murder. His investigation leads him on the trail of three women of the local upper middle class.

Title: 742. Drylanders
description: The epic story of the opening of the Canadian West and the drought that brought the Depression in the thirties. This is the saga of a family who left eastern Canada to stake their future in the Prairies.

Title: 743. Ver elini Istanbul
description: The first Turkish movie in which two women kiss each other.

Title: 745. Rebel Angel
description: Tawdry potboiler concerns a teenage girl whose boyfriend kills a child she's been babysitting once he learns of her interest in another, older man.

Title: 746. The 13th Wife
description: Murad (Rushdi Abaza) is a notorious playboy who, by the time they met Aida (Shadia), had already been married 12 times. When Aida resists his attempts to seduce her, Murad decides to propose to her, with the intent of divorcing her afterward. One of Murad's ex-fiancees reveals his past to Aida. As a result, she joins forces with his ex-wives to hatch a plot to force him to renounce his womanizing ways. Murad is deprived of sex, sleep, and is slowly being driven over the edge. Will Aida succeed in her plan to redeem Murad? Or will she end up just another notch on Murad's bed post?

Title: 747. Jia wu feng yun
description: In 1894 the Japanese Imperial Navy provokes the Chinese navy to test defenses. Some Chinese want to make concessions while others want to fight. When Japan invades, some naval officers put up a heroic resistance.

Title: 748. Foundry Town
description: Set in Kawaguchi, just north of Tokyo in the early 60s, the movie chronicles the lives of poor foundry workers and their families; and one girl's dreams of self-improvement through going on to higher education.

Title: 749. Daughter of the Sun God
description: A jungle expedition in South America battles giant snakes, crocodiles and discovers an Inca goddess.

Title: 750. Night Train to Milan
description: A gritty little intrigue thriller with Palance as an ex-nazi doctor in hiding. While riding on a train, he is recognized by passengers who remember him from their prisoner of war camp days. One thing leads to another and when Palance is cornered, he commits murder! He then takes a girl hostage.

Title: 753. Mitasareta seikatsu
description: In this new wave film for Shochiku Studio by avantgarde director Hani Susumu A young Japanese woman tries several extremes, and things in the middle, to improve herself and her contentment. She tries drama, radical politics, sluttiness and more. The director offers minimal script and lots of freedom to the cast.

Title: 754. A Zero Too Much
description: Warehouse assistant Pontus Blom accidentally get a zero to many printed in the tax calendar. This will change his life completely.

Title: 755. Hombre de la esquina rosada
description: In the year 1910, because of the first century of Independency in Argentina, the governor of Buenos Aires gives the pardon to some prisoners. One of the people who recovers his freedom is El Corralero, a hit-man who wants to change his life and decides to avoid any conflict. He returns to San Telmo. In his mind, he has the souvenirs of the story that his cell partner, Nicolás Fuente, who died before the pardon and was jailed because the treason of his ex-lover and some ex-friends. By mysterious ways, El Corralero finds that destiny is making of him the avenger of Nicolás.

Title: 756. Os Cosmonautas
description: After the success of the first Brazilian space mission, a scientist intends to accomplish an even more audacious feat. His goal is to launch into space the Nationalist rocket II, this time taking two humans to the moon.

Title: 757. Maciste contro lo sceicco
description: In the late 1500s, forces of the Duke of Malaga topple the Sacred Obelisk in the North African city of Melida before they're defeated by the local Sheik. The Shiek's men then sail to Spain and kidnap the Duke's daughter, Isabella. Antonio, who loves Isabella, now travels to Melida with his friend, Maciste, to rescue her as well as her imprisoned father. They're soon captured and Maciste is forced to single-handedly re-erect the fallen obelisk before he and Antonio make their escape. The two men then seek to finish rescuing Isabella and restoring her father to his dukedom.

Title: 758. Carnival of Crime
description: A four-alarm murder mystery, this nerve-tingling story is about a dashing, prominent builder in Brazil who is mistakenly accused of killing his wife, but because of it learns the truth about the woman he thought he knew.

Title: 759. Carmen di Trastevere
description: Carmen, wife of a certain Vincenzo detained for theft, chooses Antonio as a friend. When the husband is released from prison, he accepts the relationship in progress and continues to use the woman in his shady businesses.

Title: 760. Woman Barber
description: Hua wanted to be a professional barber, but her husband Jia didn't support her. But Hua joined a barbershop and became a popular barber when Jia was on a business leave. What will Hua do when Jia coming back?

Title: 762. The Immoral Moment
description: A traitor considered a hero after WW2.

Title: 763. Flower on the Stone
description: Set in a mining town in the Donets Basin, it centers on a clash between the political establishment and a religious cult which infiltrates the community.

Title: 764. Stagecoach to Dancers' Rock
description: Six passengers in a stagecoach are abandoned by their driver when he discovers that one of them has smallpox.

Title: 765. Priklyucheniya Krosha
description: Ninth grade students from one of the Moscow schools are undergoing summer internship at a large carpool. Having quickly become familiar with the organization of the uncomplicated work of a repairman, the guys choose a supplier from their friendly team - and everyone finds practice in something useful. Only Seryozha Krasheninnikov (Krosh), with his humanitarian abilities and complete lack of interest in technology, clearly stands out from the friendly team. But an emergency occurs: a brand-new shock absorber disappears from the warehouse, and then the car. And the observant Krosh takes on the functions of a detective.

Title: 766. Strazile au amintiri
description: During the Second World War, a writer meets two young people, a girl and a boy, who are doing actions to undermine the fascist regime in power.

Title: 770. Den kære familie
description: Days before year 1900, a successful businessman and widower has his son, 3 daughters and +1s over for dinner. Managing their lives regarding spouses is a lot more complicated than managing business deals.

Title: 771. Tadare
description: Based on the original novel by Tokuda Shusei, adaptation by Kaneto Shindo, Masumura Yasuzo directs. A battle of woman competing for the same man. Masuko (Ayako Wakao) is the number one hostess at a cabaret, living with her lover, but finds out that he has a wife.

Title: 772. Il capitano di ferro
description: Furio, the "Captain of Iron", returning to his village to find it burned to the ground by German usurper Walter von Rauchwitz, who seems to be on a one-man mission to conquer 16th century Italy and assassinate the pope.

Title: 774. The Fabiani Affair
description: Two criminal Corsican clans are fighting each other in Paris.

Title: 775. The Spanish Sword
description: A king's knight fights against a treasonous baron.

Title: 778. Teenage Yakuza
description: A high school vigilante protects his community from the extortions of mobsters from a neighboring city.

Title: 779. Big Li, Little Li and Old Li
description: Sports gain acceptance among workers at a meat processing plant.

Title: 781. Mawed fe Elborg
description: Adel and Amal meet during their return from a cruise and they fall in love and promise to marry after six months at the Cairo Tower. Will they manage to honor their promise?

Title: 782. Dong jin xuqu
description: In 1940 a New Fourth Army unit on the way to fight the Japanese finds the way blocked by Nationalist forces.

Title: 783. Haza Al Ragol Ohebboh
description: Sabreen is an orphan girl who grow up in the orphanage, by the time she is an adult she been assigned to work in one the big mansions in the countryside, the owner of the mansion hard hearted man called Murad but she gain his trust by time although she is surprised to find out that the mansion is full of sorrow and mystery, by time she finds out that there is a crazy woman who if confined to her room in the attic and she Murad's wife.

Title: 784. Abid el gassad
description: Wafaa escapes her abusive husband to work in a jewelry shop. She meets a young man trying to steal there, and they marry on the condition he stops stealing. But her life changes when her first husband is released from prison.

Title: 785. Magician's Adventure
description: A magician comes back to Shanghai to find his son separated twenty-five years ago.

Title: 786. A House of Sand
description: An unsure American girl finds love in Paris, in spite of being repulsed by an assault as a child, and is able to overcome it.

Title: 787. Cold Tracks
description: Wartime 1944. Oddmund stays at a remote cabin in the high mountains, about to lead 12 refugees out of the country. But he also awaits the most important person is his life, Ragnhild, which isn't coming.

Title: 788. Dos años de vacaciones
description: A ship sets sail with only fifteen young people on board because of a prank. After reaching an island, they must overcome their differences to organize and survive.

Title: 789. Dawn on the Third Day
description: A small Greek island is surrounded by the army of the enemy.

Title: 790. Thor
description: Thrill after thrill. spectacle beyond belief.

Title: 791. The Cursed Palace
description: A lawyer goes to prepare a testament for an old man who lives at a palace that is said to be cursed. He gets tied into a spectral mystery involving the palace's strange residents.

Title: 792. Hokori takaki chosen
description: Kuroki, a journalist working for a newspaper, is investigating the clandestine sale of arms to Southeast Asia.

Title: 793. Rikki og mændene
description: A free-spirited young woman decides, in an effort to be independent and pay her bills, to charge her lovers for her affections. When they decline, she then goes the next step and starts picking up men in bars.

Title: 795. Sol en llamas
description: Un ranchero poderoso pierde su poder y riqueza durante la revolución y su hija se enamora de un revolucionario.

Title: 796. Mars, God of War
description: The king of Telbia defeats an African army through the intervention of the war god Mars. Remaining on Earth, Mars falls in love with the human girl Daphne, but she is forced to become a priestess in the temple of Venus.

Title: 797. Bonne chance, Charlie
description: This moral drama concerns the search for a Nazi criminal who has eluded his friend for two decades but now seems to have turned up in Greece.

Title: 798. East Zone, West Zone
description: Defeated Germany has just been divided into two zones ( Soviet and Allied ) when Hans, a young inhabitant of Berlin, decides to cross the demarcation line to join his family.

Title: 800. Dead Man's Evidence
description: Spy David Baxter is sent to Ireland to investigate the death of a defected colleague apparently found dead on a beach. But is the body really him?

Title: 801. Seraa el gababera
description: Farid falls for Lillian, a Jewish dancer, she leaves him and departs for Palestine. He meets Jawaher—a dancer and the wife of Al-Seba'i—whose husband plots to kill and rob him; Farid manages to escape, only to find himself in Palestine.

Title: 802. Danger on My Side
description: With the help of the Metropolitan Police, a girl starts to track down the gang who had her detective brother killed by a speeding car. The trail leads to Nicky's club in Soho and to diamond smuggling.

Title: 803. Band of Thieves
description: Acker Bilk leads a prison jazz band. They are released and perform concerts, but soon return to crime and go back to prison, pleasing the jazz-loving governor who wanted their music to continue.

Title: 804. Bipasha
description: A son's frantic search for his mother. A wife's desperate search to get back her husband. A father's endless repentance for his mis-deeds. A revolt against society's empty rituals & rules. This is all what Bipasha comprises.

Title: 805. Schneewittchen und die sieben Gaukler
description: Swiss-German musical inspired by the story of Snow White, featering the then very popular italian singer Caterina Valente.

Title: 807. Terror After Midnight
description: The 17-year-old Julie connects by chance with the criminal outsider Nolan, who sees an opportunity to make money on the girl and have sex with her. While Nolan blackmails Julie's parents he plans to rape her.

Title: 809. Waldrausch
description: After years of absence, engineer Lutz Ambross returns to his home village Maria Schnee with the job to build a dam. He can persuade most of the residents to accept the offered compensation for their land and houses - only the greedy Crispin sets them up against Lutz to raise the price. Both do also compete for the love of Beda.

Title: 810. Eerduosi feng bao
description: A Chinese Communist Party agent helps the people of an area of Inner Mongolia struggle against the governor in the early 20th century.

Title: 811. O Vendedor de Linguiça
description: Story of a sausage salesman (Amácio Mazzaropi), a simple man struggling with family problems.

Title: 812. Tocaia no Asfalto
description: The psychology and life of Brazilian hitmen, common in the Northeast part of the country. In this particular case, the story revolves around a young and idealistic politician from Salvador, whom the enemies are eager to eliminate.

Title: 813. Labu dan Labi
description: This film tells the misadventures of a pair of bumbling servants who live with their miserly employee. During a particularly difficult night, they both dream up scenarios where they get to experience their respective fantasies whilst further incurring their employer's wrath.

Title: 814. O 5º Poder
description: Foreign agents install mind-control technology on Rio's broadcast towers, manipulating the population to destabilize Brazil. A journalist and chemist team up to investigate the bizarre occurrences and expose the plot.

Title: 815. The Memorial Gate for Virtuous Women
description: The widow of a nobleman bears a son after having an affair with her servant. The servant and the baby are driven from the home by the woman's irate in-laws when the truth is discovered. Even after the child is grown, no contact is allowed between he and his mother who now denies the events of her past.

Title: 816. Joseph the Dreamer
description: The story of the Biblical Joseph and his coat of many colors.

Title: 818. Locker Sixty Nine
description: Fraudster perpetrates deadly scam. Partner holds incriminating evidence. Amidst death threats, fraudster fakes own murder to escape consequences. Objective plot outline spanning fraud, blackmail, and faked death without exposition.

Title: 823. Cinco Vezes Favela
description: Five segments about the hardships faced by people living in slums on hills in Rio de Janeiro.

Title: 824. Lo smemorato di Collegno
description: The story takes inspiration from a real case: Bruneri/Canella, Italy 1926. A man is hospitalized in a neurological clinic, suffering from amnesia. After seeing his photo in the newspaper, Mrs. Ballerini realizes that he is her husband and brings him home; then Mrs. Polacich recognizes him as her husband. At one point he is brought to court accused of being a thief named Mr. LoBianco. Finally all of his identities are found to be false for different reasons, and he decides that from now on, it's just him and his dog.

Title: 825. Alyonka
description: Set in 1955 when many migrated from Russia to the Steppes of Kazakhstan, this is the trip back to the Canal from the frontier and farms by a number of people who tell their settler stories. Alenka Muratova (Ovodova) is a winsome 13 year old who talks Dmitry Prokovich, the chief mechanic for the Soviet, into giving up his seat in the truck to a young mother with her infant daughter. Then Alenka and Dmitry share the back of the open truck with a young woman, newly graduated dentist who has not been able to find a position, Stefan, a hitchhiker with a dog who hopes his upper-class wife will return to him and the countryside, and Vasselina Petrovolka, a woman who lost one of her twin daughters in a riding accident by the river shortly after they arrived, and now is returning to tell the other twin of her sister's fate. A warm hearted look at common folks traveling in the frontier.

Title: 826. Der rote Rausch
description: A serial killer is on the run, after escaping a mental institution. He befriends a woman and her child, but the urge to strangle women with red necklaces still haunts him.

Title: 828. Revue um Mitternacht
description: Despite the fact that production manager Kruse doesn't have the actors or the crew for the job, he recklessly boasts that he could direct a review film. To prevent him losing face, Kruse brings together four people - a dramaturg, a composer, a writer and an architect - and gives them the thankless task of turning his idea into a film. Except for the relatively unknown composer Alexander Ritter, who is enthusiastically committed to the project, the other members of the team find themselves stuck in this mess. The production assistant Claudia Glueck and the rest of the team don't count on Ritter at first because he has absolutely no experience in composing material for review films. But what he lacks in experience, he more than makes up with his creative energy and his enthusiasm for the project. Not only are all of his colleagues' doubts soon cast aside, but Ritter also wins Glueck's heart, even though she mistrusted him the most from the very beginning. How could the review help but be a roaring success?

Title: 829. Alvorada - Brazil's Changing Face
description: A documentary on Brazil in times of social changes, using avant-garde visuals, editing and sounds.

Title: 830. O diavolos kai i oura tou
description: A jealous wife is convinced that her husband is a shameless adulterer, while he, too, thinks that she is having an affair. Both will go to great lengths to get their relationship back on track; however, can they save their marriage?

Title: 831. Farewell to the Duman River
description: College students leave their homes in Korea to join in the struggle against the Japanese in Manchuria, China

Title: 833. Obedience
description: Documents the famous Milgram experiment, which measured the willingness of test subjects to obey authority in ways contrary to their own judgment and conscience.

Title: 834. Sømænd og svigermødre
description: There is bustle in the townhouse of the Middelboe family in Helsingør. The house's only daughter, the adorable Bitten, must be married and her mother, Emma Middelboe, is busy trying to find her perfect match.

Title: 835. Tateshi Danpei
description: The remake of a Akira Kurosawa script is based on the story of the actual figure Ichikawa Danpei who was a tateshi, or fencing instructor and choreographer, in Japan in the Taisho era at the beginning of the twentieth century. The sword fighting style of the man is less and less in demand as the years progress, tastes change and more realism is called for.

Title: 836. Brushfire
description: Group of farmers go to the rescue of a couple kidnapped by rebels, who want to exchange them for weapons and ammunition.

Title: 837. Der Zigeunerbaron
description: The young Sandor comes to Timisoara and immediately takes on the pig farmer Zsupan to help the gypsy girl Saffi. As a result, he has bad cards when he spontaneously falls in love with Zsupan's daughter Arsena. In the castle of the Barinkays, which fell in Ungande, Sandor meets a group of gypsies. The old Czipra realizes that Sandor is the son of the Barinkays. Sandor is looking for the family treasure and has to choose between Arsena and Saffi.

Title: 838. Mandrin
description: A change of pace for social realist Le Chanois, a swashbuckler: French Robin Hood figure Mandrin (later a hero of the Paris Commune) leads a smuggling gang against financial restrictions under Louis XV.

Title: 839. Lo sceicco rosso
description: A Spanish nobleman impersonates an architect seeking employment with a wealthy desert tyrant. Meanwhile, the mysterious Red Sheik who was supposedly killed years ago commences daring raids on behalf of the oppressed peasants.

Title: 841. Todos eran culpables
description: A group of rebellious youth find themselves in hot water when a girl is killed while they are partying

Title: 842. Seki snima, pazi se
description: A group of young men suggests that the local tinsmith should make a film, and he agrees--only if the director could be his cousin Seki, soccer legend of Red Star FC. But Seki thinks that film-making is the same thing as a soccer match, which causes many arguments among film-crew members.

Title: 843. Love Hunger
description: Three bank robbers on the lam, holing up in an isolated river cabin, catch sight of an ethereal girl. Is she real or the ghost legend the locals call the "Irupé flower"?

Title: 844. Issi Ka Naam Dunia Hai
description: Motiram, a textile mill worker, has lost his wife and he marries Radha, despite protest from his children Raja and Asha. Radha starts playing a step mother, as a result both children run away for Mumbai. Raja finds it difficult to make fast money for a respectable living and his sister's studies. He starts gambling as a freelancer and goes on to become a top notch gambler with playing cards. Verma, owner of an underground casino, offers him a lucrative job and Raja joins him. Soon he finds that he is love with an orphan girl Kamla and Asha with Inspector Shyam. However, his job will be an obstacle for his sister's marriage into a respectable family, so he decides to leave Verma's job and start afresh. He lands in many jobs but his infamous past always haunts him. In order to get Asha married in a respectable manner he borrows some money from Verma. He fixes Asha's marriage but Verma wants his money back in two days' time. Reluctantly he steals required money from Seth Motiram's house and goes to Verma's place to pay his money back. He has an altercation with Verma and Verma falls from a height. Dying Verma names Raja for his conditions. Police arrests Raja for murdering Verma. Motiram comes to Raja's house and finds that Raja and Asha are his children. It is proved in the court that Raja did steal money but did not kill Verma. He gets eight years imprisonment for his crime.

Title: 847. Gli anni ruggenti
description: The incognito visit of a fascist hierarch in a tiny country town shakes deeply the ruling class and their lack of integrity.

Title: 848. The Great Chase
description: A great compilation of the greatest chase/stunt/falls and dangerous sequences from the early years of cinema, long before stuntman become a real profession with more and more thrilling feats to be conquered. The documentary includes amazing stunts by the likes of Buster Keaton, Douglas Fairbanks, Lillian Gish and many others.

Title: 849. Night of the Prowler
description: When the director of a successful racing car company is shot dead the other directors have reason to believe their lives are at risk too. Suspect number one is an ex-employee just released from gaol who went down on their evidence.

Title: 850. Ihr schönster Tag
description: Concierge Anni Wiesner runs a strict regiment in her basement apartment in Berlin. Not only her husband Karl, but also the other tenants knows that order is the top priority.

Title: 851. Obracun
description: In this sequel to "Captain Leshi", a group of Albanian nationalist movement (ballists) continues obstruction of the new Yugoslavian authorities even after the war. Captain Leshi manages to fight them successfully, as well as to fulfill his romance with beautiful Azira.

Title: 852. Nakli Nawab
description: A nawab's sister falls in love with a pickpocket who is also a poet. However, due to their social status, they cannot be together, which makes the woman give up hope.

Title: 853. The Husband of My Wife
description: A philandering pharmacist has a chance encounter with an alluring blonde stranger who insists that she is his wife. Now, a revered psychiatrist attempts to shed light on a curious case of split personality. Who's the husband of his wife?

Title: 854. The Deadly Decoy
description: A French Secret Agente known as THE GORILLA (Roger Hanin), is sent to French West Africa to stop a planned political assassination of a railway chairman. Larry Anderson.

Title: 855. A Woman Judge
description: A husband is jealous because his wife is a judge, an occupation high on the social ladder. His stepmother harasses the judge, using his jealousy against her. And his sister also has no intention to give peace to her sister-in-law. But the judge tries her best to do her two duties as a judge and as a wife.

Title: 857. Juventud sin Dios (La vida del padre Lambert)
description: A Priest becomes a football Coach to help young in troubles to get a chance in life. Representing the 2 Top Mexican Universities in Mexico.

Title: 858. La viudita naviera
description: During the Cádiz Carnival the beautiful Candelaria marries Pimentel, an elderly merchant ship captain. Pimentel is ordered to set sail immediately for Cuba and dies there. Candelaria becomes ''La viudita naviera''

Title: 859. Universo di notte
description: Beginning in Las Vegas with a dance of the Bluebells, we are shown a variety, with jugglers, singers, Thai boxing, cock fighting and so on. A Variety taking place in Hong Kong, Manila, New York, Paris, Cremona. The break between an act and the next being a striptease.

Title: 860. Journey
description: A poor, Greek girl named Marina tries to find love and leave her miserable life in the slums.

Title: 861. Alaverdoba
description: In the midst of Alaverdoba, an ordinal person plays out a trick to awake pilgrims and their moral spirits, and to remind them of the true meanings of the religious festival.

Title: 862. Los jóvenes viejos
description: The frustrations felt by certain middle class youth in 1960s Argentina under the new presidency of Arturo Frondizi, one of whom works in the media, a criticism of the false moral values of that time.

Title: 863. Das süsse Leben des Grafen Bobby
description: Graf Bobby and Baron Mucki founded the detective bureau Pfiff and Greif to finally make money. Shortly before the bankruptcy of their company, they receive a lucrative order from Benevenuto Socrates Socre regarding a gang of girl traders.

Title: 864. Sabían demasiado
description: A gang of Spanish pickpockets decide to send one of them to Chicago to learn how to be a gangster...

Title: 865. Dakshayagnam
description: When the king Daksha's daughter Sati marries Shiva against his wish, he performs a yagna to insult Shiva. So, Sati jumps into the fire and dies. Knowing this, Shiva becomes furious and decapitates Daksha.

Title: 866. Secrets of the Nazi Criminals
description: Documents the major trial of the Nazi war criminals and the violent acts that they were accused of.

Title: 867. Sono basho ni onna arite
description: Story of romance and rivalry between two ad agencies vying for the same account with a pharmaceutical firm.

Title: 868. Onnakeizu
description: Adaptation of a famous Kyouka Izumi novel. Set in the early 1900's, it tells the story of the impossible love between a young scholar a beautiful geisha.

Title: 869. Ühe küla mehed
description: After a stormy night on the sea, a group of Estonian fishermen end up in a small coastal Finnish town. As they await the Soviet authorities to take them back home, some of the fishermen contemplate leaving their former lives in a Soviet era Estonia behind.

Title: 871. White Gold
description: Etemad owns a cabaret in which they smuggle drugs too. Husband of Fariba the singer of the cabaret is getting killed. Now his brother Amir is back from America to find the murderers and get revenge.

Title: 873. Womanhunt
description: Hal Weston arrives in Los Angeles in search of his ex-wife Nora Petrie, whose current husband, Petrie, once a partner with Weston in the import business, recently died. Nora divorced Hal shortly after Petrie, who was using the firm as a front for smuggling dope, escaped from the New York police. Weston contacts Osgood, a former employee of Petrie's, and asks him to aid in the search for Nora. In the Oriental section of L.A., he learns from Li Sheng that Nora was a dope addict. Also learning that Nora had plans of going to the Orient on her husband's insurance money, he discovers that the picture on her passport belongs to another woman. He confronts Dr. Sheng, Li Sheng's father, about Petrie's death certificate. Later, receiving a call from Dr. Sheng to meet him at the Observatory, Weston is attacked by two thugs but escapes. Li Sheng is waiting for him and accuses him of murdering her father. Nora's body has been discovered in Petrie's coffin,proving to Weston that Petrie killed Nora, bribed the mortuary assistant to put her in a casket with his name on it after bribing Dr. Sheng to falsify his death certificate, and hired another woman to masquerade as Nora. He learns the whereabouts of Petrie from Janet Oberon, the woman posing as Nora. He finds Petrie with his face swathed in bandages, the result of plastic surgery by Dr. Sheng. Osgood enters with a gun, shielding himself behind Li Sheng, and stops Weston from attacking Petrie. The latter is forced to remove his bandages when Weston throws alcohol in his face and his face has been changed to resemble Osgood.

Title: 875. Malesia magica
description: Malaysia between past and future. An uncontaminated and pure past living in the ancient traditions and the vicious present we find in the cities contaminated from western civilization: this is the subject of the documentary, which, beginning from Buddha, arrives to the prostitution in the eastern cities, all alike and bad.

Title: 876. Liberté 1
description: A Senegalese couple struggle to balance traditional and modern values as their country becomes independent.

Title: 877. One Fine Day
description: A story set in a Slovenian village during Italian occupation. Stefuc, a man who has been widowed twice and has four daughters, wants to get married for the third time with Zana, who's already engaged and pregnant with Ludvik. Stefuc tries to separate them away, but realizes that he'll have to marry Hedvika, a nice looking girl who has just returned from Milan. In the meantime, Italian fascist authorities decide to eradicate five Slovenian songs with the help of local traitors.

Title: 878. Soldaterkammerater på sjov
description: Ras has become a lieutenant in the hunter's corps and comes to visit his old barracks. Here he meets all his former recruits, who are still under Vældegaards command.

Title: 879. Banarasi Thug
description: Shyam travels to another town to meet the girl his mother would like him to marry. On his way, he meets a villager who traps Shyam in his home, with a view to force Shyam to marry his daughter.

Title: 880. Dada Thakur
description: The film is based closely on the life of the real-life Dada Thakur, and was made in his lifetime. Dada Thakur (Chhabi Biswas) starts his career with a hand-operated press, with his wife as his assistant. Later he is joined by Nalini Kanta Sarkar, an underground freedom-fighter. Dada Thakur brings out the newspaper Jangipur Sangbad. He campaigns against social evils and earns the ire of the ruling classes. He saves a girl, Lata, from the unwanted advances of Darpanarayan (Biswajit Chatterjee), son of the local landholder. Lata joins the ranks of freedom fighters working with Sarkar. Subsequently, a reformed Darpanarayan too becomes an ardent follower of Dada Thakur and joins the struggle for India's freedom. Dada Thakur's greatest success is when he helps an ordinary man, a petty shopkeeper, get elected as the Municipal Commissioner of Jangipur.

Title: 881. Wedding Celebration
description: The life of an impoverished male undergoes drastic changes after he gets his siblings married.

Title: 882. Orgi
description: With hatred burning inside her black heart, a mean-spirited woman wants to have nothing to do with her polar opposite half-sister. Then, a car accident sets the stage for revenge, and no one is safe from harm. Can someone appease her rage?

Title: 883. Gang vs Gang
description: Mizuhara did his time in jail for Boss Komori. Now that he is out, the old gang wants to say welcome back with a bullet.

Title: 884. Zbabelec
description: In this moral study of heroism set in a remote Slovak village in the closing days of World War II, a schoolteacher and his young wife find a wounded Soviet parachutist in their front yard just as the Germans are coming in to occupy their village. As his wife readily becomes involved with anti-German partisans, the schoolteacher collaborates with the Germans, but at the end of his humiliation, finds the courage to save his honor and the innocent victims of the Germans.

Title: 885. Los que no fuimos a la guerra
description: World War I (1914-1918). In a provincial environment of neutral Spain, two families face and be involved in embarrassing episodes because each one defends a different faction. This situation even causes the rupture of a courtship.

Title: 886. Third of a Man
description: "Third of a Man," as in general do all movies, offers a peek back at how mental illnesses were misperceived and at times punished through misperceptions. The story offers a redemptive conclusion.

Title: 888. Pecado
description: An old sailor is betrayed and killed by his young beautiful wife and her lover, searching of a shipwreck with gold ingots, the product of a robbery, in a Central America river.

Title: 889. The Flamboyant Sex
description: 24 hours in the life of three Swedish girls in Paris. Seduced by the excitement but short of money they earn a few francs as nude models in an art school.

Title: 890. Girls on the Rocks
description: After their yacht sinks in a storm, an all-girl orchestra is washed up on a deserted island... and immediately start singing and playing their instruments on the shore. Within minutes they also discover a handsome loin-cloth-wearing muscleman in a tree. The girls are impressed, especially when he starts to flex, but the girls' prissy chaperone won't let Karzin come too near. But that changes when a bunch of cannibals attack and destroy their hut before Karzin chases them away. With their shelter in ruins, Karzin guides them to his elaborate estate: a beautifully-furnished adobe mansion complete with records, paintings, and a TV set, allegedly the remains of other shipwrecks.

Title: 895. Sexy al neon
description: European night-club attractions and their sexy numbers

Title: 896. Venus fra Vestø
description: Vestø island's isolated community's prize cow is in danger of being abducted by German WWII occupation forces.

Title: 897. The Magnificent Concubine
description: Lady Yuhuan Yang is the beloved Imperial Concubine of the Chinese Emperor. Her brother Yang, the Prime Minister, is corrupt and the Fanyang Chief revolts and imperils the throne. This has grave consequences for the Yangs and the Emperor.

Title: 898. Le rendez-vous de minuit
description: A woman becomes distressed by the resemblance between the plot of a film and the reality of her own life. But what is reality - life or film?

Title: 900. Vamos a contar mentiras
description: A happily married woman is distinguished by her ability to lie constantly. Her husband reproaches her that she is unoccupied, and that is where her liking for lies comes from. One night, the maid opens the door to her boyfriend who, together with a partner, intends to raid the house.

Title: 902. Det stod i avisen
description: 6 Danish human interest stories based on 6 newspaper ads in 1962: chest, typewriter, small apartment, baby carriage, employment for couple, room for rent and the 7th story on how the journalist met his love via "Dress for sale".

Title: 903. Sokak kizi
description: A cross-class romance where constructor's son Fikret discovers the delights of living in Istanbul's less bourgeois areas with a live-wire girlfriend.

Title: 905. Svinedrengen og prinsessen på ærten
description: A young prince is looking for a princess. He disguises himself as a pig boy about seeking work with a king.

Title: 907. Detective con faldas
description: A journalist's wife tries to convince millionaire Napoleon to grant her husband an exclusive interview. A misunderstanding, an accident, and a death. A comedy of intrigue and confusion.

Title: 911. Number Six
description: The police have never been able to charge Mr Valentine but that doesn't mean he is a honest man. A policeman sets out to finally bring him to justice.....

Title: 912. Bride Napping
description: The story begins with the talented scholar Bian Ji, who lives in the flower fields and sells paintings for a living. He falls in love with a young lady from an official family at first sight, but the story is fraught with twists and turns.

Title: 914. Teresa de Jesús
description: The life and tribulations of Carmelist nun Teresa de Jesús, who had transcendental experiences. She would write several works and would reform the Carmelist order.

Title: 915. ...und deine Liebe auch
description: In East-Berlin brothers Ullrich and Klaus vie for the attention of mail woman Eva. Klaus works in the West sector for good money, but the erection of the Berlin Wall in 1961 changes this overnight and escalates the brotherly conflict.

Title: 916. Frightened
description: Blackmailed over extramarital love letters, Roshanak shoots her tormentor to protect her marriage to a crime writer. Instead of ending her nightmare, the murder plunges her into a chilling web of deceit and escalating horror.

Title: 917. Ruletero a toda marcha
description: A small-town man moves to the big city and becomes a taxi driver to earn money, but his new life takes unexpected turns.

Title: 918. Wenn die Musik spielt am Wörthersee
920. A Fat Head
description: A man inherits an old house in a very bad condition. With the help of a young mechanic, he begins to renovate this house.

Title: 921. Emraa fi dawama
description: The story revolves around a combat nurse, her daughter's fiancé Nadia dies in an accident, and then she discovers that her daughter is pregnant, and when Nadia gives birth to her child Fathiya, the mother replaces her with a dead child.

Title: 922. Feria en Sevilla
description: Rafael dreams on becoming a great singer but his good but abusive father insists that he becomes a bullfighter.

Title: 923. Rogelia
description: Rogelia marries the man she doesn't want and rejects the one she does because of social conventions, living surrounded by evil for herself and others.

Title: 926. Gaali Medalu
description: Gaali Medula is a tear-jerking tale of a young man Krishna on the lookout for his father. Ranganatham leaves his only son Krishna in the custody of Panakalu before he leaves for his medical treatment. Greedy Panakalu leaves the village with the money given by Krishna's father and buys a piece of land in town. He educates his son Mohan and makes Krishna look after the land. Panakalu also takes money from Naganna as loan, in exchange to make Lakshmi his daughter-in-law. Lakshmi who is in love with Krishna is unaware that she has to marry Mohan. Panakalu accuses Krishna of ruining the marriage plans of Lakshmi and Mohan, which makes Krishna leave the house. Meanwhile, the ambitious Mohan on the pretext of becoming a millionaire meets Nimmi who is the landlord's daughter and marries her. This makes Lakshmi leave the house in search of Krishna. Will the two reunite? And will Krishna be able to meet his father again?

Title: 927. Sino ang matapang
description: They fought - they suffered - they died - but they live forever.

Title: 931. Pathan
description: A fearless man dedicates his life to exposing corrupt officials and fighting for justice. When a young woman is sent in disguise to destroy him, she falls in love with him instead. Together, they unite to take down the criminal network.

Title: 932. Glos z tamtego swiata
description: Four victims of a quack medium find life on earth unsatisfactory in one way or another, and try to find concolation in ptent medicines or the voices from another world, kindly provided by the medium.

Title: 933. Stark Mad Astronauts
description: A scientist decides to start a space program. He enlists a handyman to help build the ship, his chauffeur, and a friend to guard their workshop.

Title: 935. O hrysos kai o tenekes
description: A super market owner opposes the affair of his daughter with a new employee at his business.

Title: 936. Desert War
description: Four Nights with Alba (1962). A woman is found in an abandoned truck in the middle of the Libyan Desert by a small group of Italian soldiers.

Title: 937. Gang War
description: During the early 60s, a Chicago mobster and a Londoner try to get involved in a jukebox racket.

Title: 938. Koi to Taiyo to Gang
description: Ishihama is planning a casino robbery with his wife and mother-in-law. They meet a man named Tsuneda who was aiming to do the same thing so they decide to work together.

Title: 939. Martín Santos el llanero
description: A marriage of convenience between a llanero and a wealthy woman becomes a true love that transcends class differences.

Title: 940. Golmokan punggyeong
description: One father finds life nearly impossible to live as he attempts to raise his nine children on a pitifully small salary.

Title: 941. El ataúd infernal
description: Arturo fails in a singing contest on TV. But he gets a second chance, thanks to the fistol that the devil has given him in exchange for his soul and his freedom.

Title: 942. La entrega de Chucho el Roto
944. The Fur Collar
description: Reporter feigns death in order to trap a fugitive and uncover a spy ring.

Title: 951. Aniki
description: A gangster action film whose plot revolves around the brotherly bond between a street thug and his strong bodyguard, and their fight against injustice.

Title: 952. A esli eto lyubov?
description: High schoolers Ksenia and Boris begin to understand that the feelings they share are more than just a friendship. But their first timid sentiment became apparent to people around them. They have to confront mocking schoolmates and hypocritical and rude grown-ups.

Title: 953. Dilemma
description: Around 1960, Englishman Toby Hood comes to Johannesburg to run a publishing company. He is open-minded and befriends people with different social ranks, but the harsh realities of society force him to make a choice about friendships.

Title: 954. Psila ta heria Hitler
description: Two bosom friends who had believed each other dead reunite during an excursion. As they reconnect, they fondly reminisce about their shared struggle for survival in Nazi-occupied Athens during the dark years of World War II.

Title: 955. Nakayama shichiri
description: Masakichi was a troublemaker until he found a right girl to marry. Unfortunately, his happiness is short-lived - she kills herself after being raped.

Title: 956. Gabros gia klamata
description: A masterful thief entrusts a poor petty criminal with the secret code of a grand treasure; however, a fateful meeting with the landlord's kind daughter will pave the way for a reluctant and unexpected romance. Can she straighten him out?

Title: 957. Gli italiani e le donne
description: A group of vignettes about men, mostly married, scheming to get women and the funny ways the schemes play out.

Title: 958. Das Mädchen und der Staatsanwalt
description: A mother is sentenced to one year in prison for matchmaking her underage daughter with her adult boyfriend.

Title: 961. Minna von Barnhelm
description: This film takes place during the Seven Years' War. The Prussian Major von Tellheim has become engaged to the Saxon noblewoman Minna von Barnhelm. After the war, the King - in an unwarranted move - deprives the major of his honor. Von Tellheim becomes impoverished and, filled with shame, breaks off his relationship to Minna. An innkeeper in Berlin, who is a police informer, makes the Major move to a shabby little attic because he cannot pay his debt. In the meantime, Minna has also arrived at the inn. She and her lady's maid Franziska are questioned and spied on by the nosy innkeeper. Minna has followed her beloved Tellheim and she now cunningly manages to elicit a new declaration of love from him. Because he is so focused on maintaining his honor she keeps him in suspense for quite a while before telling him that the King has reinstated him. Minna and Tellheim become a happy couple and Franziska, too, finds the love of her life - Werner, a sergeant. A sweeping story of love, pride and betrayal. Based on the drama by Gotthold Ephraim Lessing.

Title: 963. Four for the Morgue
description: Detective film presenting the cases of two New Orleans detectives. One is about a patrolman who is suspected of murdering a socialite kleptomaniac, and one about the murderer of a bank robber whose corpse was found in a swamp.

Title: 967. La barranca sangrienta
description: Alberto and Leonor have a son, they find out that one of the masked men who attacked them was her nephew, things get difficult for them when they find out about a testament left by her grandmother.

Title: 968. El televisor
description: With the expansion of television in Argentina people changed their customs and schedules. This is the story of a family father who refuses to change his own, but who suffers after having acquired a television set.

Title: 969. Mangayir Ullam Mangada Selvam
description: Movie starring Gemini Ganesan, M. R. Radha, Anjali Devi and is directed by Vedantam Raghavaiah. The Movie has Unimaginatively contrived, the film is vivid and artistic, without being precise. Its pictorial imagery falls to blend with the story content, which is thin and far in excess of the usual padding and synthetic thrills

Title: 972. Tears of Joy
description: Facing bankruptcy, Amir forces his fiancée to seduce his rich friend Hamid. The scheme destroys Hamid's life, but when tragedy claims the conspirators, a destitute Hamid returns home to seek his wife's forgiveness.

Title: 973. Yûkai
description: A thrilling detective story based on the original novel by Takagi Akimitsu. A wealthy and extremely greedy financial company owner, hated by many, searches for his kidnapped son, whose abductor is an unexpected person.

Title: 974. Yama no sanka: moyuru wakamono tachi
976. Face of Terror
description: A scientist develops a serum that can eradicate scar tissue. He tries it on a girl with a horribly disfigured face. It succeeds, but then he discovers the girl is an escaped mental patient from a local asylum.

Title: 977. I Athina ti nyhta
description: A musical potpourri of unpublished theatrical skits and solo performances by beloved A-listers of the 1960s Greek entertainment industry. The film captures the glamour and sophistication of the era, offering insight into Athens' nightlife.

Title: 978. The Endless Shore
description: The incident occurred in the 1960s on the Black Sea coast of Romania between two young men-a Romanian soldier on leave and a Russian tourist who traveled to the area in search of her father, who had perished in the war.

Title: 979. Terror of the Bloodhunters
description: An escaped prisoner flees to the South American jungle, where he must survive not only wild animals and disease, but a ferocious native tribe.

Title: 980. Chiragh Jalta Raha
description: A headteacher opposes a greedy politician's attempt to forcibly marry his daughter to the headteacher's son. This sparks a chain of events involving relocation, kidnapping, imprisonment, and eventual downfall of the corrupt politician.

Title: 981. Belali torun
description: Captain Bey's only dream is to have a grandson. His daughter Bedriye knows this and therefore she keeps her daughter Kamuran away from her father for years, raising her in Europe.

Title: 982. Anne Bäbi Jowäger - II. Teil: Jakobli und Meyeli
description: The further trials of the wealthy Emmentaler farming family Jowäger and their neighbors, adapted from the second volume of the 19th century novel by Jeremias Gotthelf (pen-name of Albert Bitzius).

Title: 983. Ranmuthu Duwa
description: The movie is about the discovery of an underwater treasure. It involves a mixture of ancient legends, human treachery and romance.

Title: 986. Kermis in de regen
description: Freddy & Willy are planning to rob a bank during at night during a funfair.

Title: 987. Kiralik koca
description: The story of a maiden with crippled feet and a hired husband found by a millionaire father.

Title: 988. Keepers of Order
description: Chuji and his family become the primary target of gangs in Nikko headed by Hasshu marshal Nakayama and boss Sukegoro Iioka. Chuji is then aided by boss Shigezo Sasagawa, Ishimatsu, and a few young yakuza.

Title: 989. Rana jesen
description: A young daughter resents another man coming into the life of her divorced mother.

Title: 990. Three Spare Wives
description: Man inherits a harem of three wives from his Uncle which he brings home to his wife in England.

Title: 991. Okinawa kaidan: Sakazuri yûrei - Shina kaidan: Shikan yaburi
992. A girl who screams
description: Deceived and left homeless by a treacherous man, a desperate young woman crosses paths with a kind-hearted hero. He helps her rebuild her shattered life and vows to seek revenge against the villain who originally ruined her.

Title: 993. Cuba '58
description: A reconstruction of the start of the triumphant Cuban revolution which deposed Batista. It includes asserters of interviews with those involved with the revolution.

Title: 996. Biljett till paradiset
description: A young woman owns a garden center outside Stockholm. Her two employees, a Swede and an Italian, has private dreams and desires to meet. The Italian plan to take revenge on a fellow countryman.

Title: 997. Sasurai
description: A musical melodrama about a former aerial acrobatics instructor who faces the consequences of a long-ago accident and a new conspiracy.

Title: 999. The Norman Vincent Peale Story
description: The true story of Dr. Norman Vincent Peale.
